name: Jochen Van Nuys, Minister of the Office of Western Affairs

system.concept: Former Prince of San Francisco, now Camarilla liaison to the New Promise Mandarinate
system.title: Minister, Office of Western Affairs
system.biography:
Background

Jochen Van Nuys arrived in San Francisco from the East Coast in 1994 as a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} wunderkind and took the Princedom from the ineffectual Prince Vannevar Thomas within two years. His rule failed to deliver the results the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} expected, and when Cathayan vampires invaded and seized the city, an unflattering report from a visiting @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} Justicar sealed his fate. In January 2001 the Inner Circle stripped him of the Princedom and reassigned him as chief liaison between the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} and the Quincunx, tasked with welcoming his replacement, Sara Anne Winder, with genuine hospitality despite his diminished station.

Roleplaying Hints

Van Nuys plays intermediary between the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} and the Cloud Mandarins, relaying the Mandarins' confidential threats to the Inner Circle while quietly hoping to regain a Princedom — even one under Kuei-jin sufferance. His secret weakness is his blood-bound ghoul-turned-childe Peter Kwan, now secretly an akuma agent of Chan Te's Hollow City wu and the Yama King Mikaboshi, feeding Van Nuys' intelligence straight to the enemy.
system.notes: Sire: Irving Boldger. Secretly compromised: his childe Peter Kwan is an akuma double agent serving Chan Te and Yama King Mikaboshi. Vulnerable to manipulation by both the Mandarinate and his own bloodline.

vtmlarp.source: San Francisco by Night, Chapter Five: Honored Shen
